DECISION GRANTING INTERVENOR COMPENSATION
TO WILD TREE FOUNDATION
Summary
This decision modifies the intervenor compensation award granted to
Wild Tree Foundation (Wild Tree) in Decision (D.) 22-11-036. While D.22-11-036
awarded Wild Tree intervenor compensation for its contributions to D.21-04-030
- 1 -
609452449

A.20-04-023, A.20-04-023 ALJ/RWH/jds/smt
and D.21-05-015 the 2020 and 2021 hourly rates for Wild Tree’s representative
Aaron Rothschild were calculated incorrectly. Accordingly, this decision adjusts
those hourly rates and awards Wild Tree an additional $31,745. This total reflects
an additional $27,062.50 for its contribution to D.21-04-030, and $4,682.50 for its
contribution to D.21-05-015.
Application 20-04-023 remains closed. Application 21-01-004 is closed.
1. Background
On November 18, 2022, the Commission issued Decision (D.) 22-11-036,
awarding intervenor compensation to Wild Tree Foundation (Wild Tree) for its
substantial contribution to D.21-04-0301 and D.21-05-0152 in Applications (A.) 20-
04-023 and A.21-01-004.
D.22-11-036 awarded Wild Tree $198,952.40 in intervenor compensation
($168,367.50 for D.21-04-030 and $30,584.90 for D.21-05-015), and adopted a 2020
hourly rate of $340 and a 2021 hourly rate of $380 for representative Aaron
Rothschild (Rothschild).
On December 14, 2022, Wild Tree filed an application for rehearing of
D.22-11-036, stating legal error in establishing Rothschild’s 2020 and 2021 rates,

A.20-04-023, A.20-04-023 ALJ/RWH/jds/smt
and requested a recalculation of the rates commensurate with the expert’s
demonstrated experience.
On April 27, 2023, the Commission issued D.23-04-060, granting limited
rehearing of D.22-11-036, and agreed that Rothschild’s 2020 and 2021 hourly
rates should be recalculated.3
2. Rothschild’s New 2020
and 2021 Hourly Rates
In D.22-11-036, the 2020 and 2021 hourly rates for Rothschild were
established using the cost-of-living adjustment (COLA) in Resolution ALJ-387,
and the market rate study in Resolution ALJ-393, respectively. However, these
calculations were based on an incorrect experience level of 13 years instead of 19
years.4
Accordingly, this decision awards Rothschild a 2020 hourly rate of $465 as
authorized in D.23-04-060 and per Resolution ALJ-387 based on his correct
experience level, as opposed to the $340 rate previously determined in D.22-11-
036, for work performed in these proceedings. Based on the 154 hours awarded
for Rothschild’s 2020 work, Wild Tree should receive an additional $19,250 in
intervenor compensation.
Additionally, this decision awards Rothschild a 2021 hourly rate of $630 as
authorized in D.23-04-060 and subsequently adopted in D.24-03-062 based on his
correct experience level, as opposed to the $380 rate previously determined in
D.22-11-036, for work performed in these proceedings. Based on the 49.98 hours

awarded for Rothschild’s 2021 work, Wild Tree should receive an additional
$12,495 in intervenor compensation.
For the reasons stated above, this decision awards Wild Tree an additional
$31,745 in intervenor compensation for its substantial contribution to D.21-04-030
and D.21-05-015. This total reflects an additional $27,062.50 for its contribution
to D.21-04-030, and $4,682.50 for its contribution to D.21-05-015.
3. Comments on Proposed Decision
Per Rule 14.6(c)(6) of the Commission’s Rules of Practice and Procedure,
the Commission may reduce or waive the period for public review and comment
for a decision on a request for compensation pursuant to Public Utilities Code
Section 1801 et seq. Because this is a decision on a request for compensation, we
waive the comment period.
4. Assignment of Proceeding
John Reynolds is the assigned Commissioner and Robert Haga is the
assigned Administrative Law Judge in these proceedings.
Findings of Fact
1. In D.22-11-036, the 2020 and 2021 hourly rates for Wild Tree’s
representative Aaron Rothschild were calculated incorrectly, as they were based
on an incorrect experience level of 13 years instead of 19 years.
2. Aaron Rothschild’s 2020 hourly rate for work performed in these
proceedings should be $465 as opposed to $340, as previously authorized in
D.22-11-036.
3. Aaron Rothschild’s 2021 hourly rate for work performed in these
proceedings should be $630 as opposed to $380, as previously authorized in
D.22-11-036.
- 4 -

A.20-04-023, A.20-04-023 ALJ/RWH/jds/smt
4. Based on the hours awarded in D.22-11-036 for work performed by Aaron
Rothschild in 2020 and 2021, Wild Tree is owed an additional $31,745 in
intervenor compensation for its contribution to D.21-04-030 and D.21-05-015. This
total reflects an additional $27,062.50 for its contribution to D.21-04-030, and
$4,682.50 for its contribution to D.21-05-015.
Conclusions of Law
1. Wild Tree should be awarded an additional $31,745 in intervenor
compensation for its contribution to D.21-04-030 and D.21-05-015.
O R D E R
IT IS ORDERED that:
1. Wild Tree Foundation is awarded an additional $27,062.50 for its
contribution to Decision 21-04-030.
2. Within 30 days of the effective date of this decision, Pacific Gas and
Electric Company shall pay Wild Tree Foundation the additional award.
Payment of the award shall include compound interest at the rate earned on
prime, three-month non-financial commercial paper as reported in Federal
Reserve Statistical Release H.15, beginning November 10, 2021, the 75th day after
the filing of Wild Tree Foundation’s request, and continuing until full payment is
made.
3. Wild Tree Foundation is awarded an additional $4,682.50 for its
contribution to Decision 21-05-015.
4. Within 30 days of the effective date of this decision, Pacific Gas and
Electric Company shall pay Wild Tree Foundation the additional award.
Payment of the award shall include compound interest at the rate earned on
